title: From rough local mass to logarithmic spectral ladders for damped waves
summary: We prove an exact inverse theorem for damped waves on $X=\mathbb{T}\times Y$ with arbitrary bounded measurable transverse damping $a=a(x)\geq 0$. Let $Θ_a(r)$ be the least average of $a$ on radius-$r$ intervals. Then $\liminf_{r\downarrow 0}Θ_a(r)>0$ characterizes exponential stability, while for every $L(S)=\ell(\log(eS))$ with $\ell:[1,\infty)\to[1,\infty)$ nondecreasing, unbounded, and eventually doubling, $Θ_a(r)\gtrsim L(1/r)^{-1}$ is equivalent to stationary- and generator-resolvent bounds $O(|s|^{-1}L(|s|))$ and $O(L(|s|))$.
